patches_added.description: Lets PineDrama's comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments, like TikTok does. TikTok's server still decides whether your account can post one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_removed.name: Always upload in HD
patches_removed.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_removed.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_removed.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_removed.name: Story controls
patches_removed.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story on a story whose creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Automatic video advance
patches_modified.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Load all saved stickers
patches_modified.description: Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Open the comments at full height
patches_modified.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches_added.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story on a story whose creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Boost Splash Screen Time
patches_modified.description: Dont Apply These Patches Over Some Other Persons Mod, Use Untouched Apk. Disables MX Player's welcome/splash ad so playback starts immediately. Also removes startup network calls and the splash logo.

patches_modified.name: Clean Me Tab
patches_modified.description: Adds Mod Settings switches, on by default, that hide promo rows, unused tiles, and Private Folder / File Transfer / Add to Playlist entries.

patches_modified.name: Configure Smart Enhance
patches_modified.description: Removes the Smart Enhance disable toast and adds Mod Settings switches for the intro popup and the enable toast.

patches_modified.name: Configure SpeedUp overlay
patches_modified.description: Fixes the stock leftover-visible-view bug in the long-press SpeedUp overlay. "No UI" is toggled in Me tab > Mod Settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable Bottom Bar And Add Me Tab To Top
patches_modified.description: Adds a permanent Me tab button to the toolbar. Hiding the bottom bar itself is toggled live in Me tab > Mod Settings, not here - the Me tab button always stays wired, on purpose, since Mod Settings lives behind it and turning it off should never be able to lock you out of turning it back on.

patches_modified.name: Kill Signature Verification
patches_modified.description: Patches libmx-bh.so to kill signature verification.

patches_modified.name: Remove Recycle Bin
patches_modified.description: Deleted files are always removed permanently, whenever this patch is applied - there's no safe way to make that half a runtime switch without the stock (unpatched) delete-dialog code to fall back to. The Me tab tile itself is a Mod Settings switch: off just brings the tile back, it doesn't restore recycling.

patches_modified.name: Replace FFmpeg codec
patches_modified.description: Replaces libffmpeg.mx.so in every lib/<abi>/ folder present in the APK with the matching file from a selected codec zip (EAC3 support). neon64 -> arm64-v8a, neon -> armeabi-v7a, x86 -> x86, x86_64 -> x86_64. ABI folders missing from the APK or from the zip are skipped.

patches_modified.name: Sidebar & Player Defaults
patches_modified.description: Cleans the player sidebar and More menu; sets default shortcuts and subtitle view. Configurable in Mod Settings, except the default shortcuts bitmask, still a Morphe option pending its Mod Settings move.

patches_modified.name: Smart Enhance Always On
patches_modified.description: Applies Smart Enhance to every video at a level set in Mod Settings, and keeps it after lock/unlock.

patches_modified.name: Smart Enhance Slider
patches_modified.description: Replaces the Smart Enhance toggle with a 0-100% popup slider and keeps the level after lock/unlock.

patches_added.name: Alpha-0 high-resolution trigger (experimental)
patches_added.description: Clears the high-resolution trigger quad's 1/255 alpha byte so it is fully transparent on exact 2.0.20/5001712. Build: 2.0.20/5001712.

patches_added.name: Codecs Support
patches_added.description: Lets the headset decode H.264 or AV1 streams; HEVC is untouched. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Needs: the matching driver codec setting.

patches_added.name: Controller grip haptics through Shizuku
patches_added.description: Sends controller vibration to the grip motor instead of the trigger. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. This needs Shizuku running with permission granted; without it vibration stays stock. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches_added.name: Controller pose extrapolation
patches_added.description: Predicts controller poses to the moment the app asks and smooths out jitter. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches_added.name: Controller pose time (experimental)
patches_added.description: Dates each controller pose by its sample time; the runtime labels poses 28.82 ms late. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Needs: not with Controller pose extrapolation or the HAL pose patch. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches_added.name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku
patches_added.description: Reads controller poses from the headset HAL, removing about 35 ms of lag. This needs Shizuku; without it tracking stays stock. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Angular velocity is local to the grip pose on 2.0.23/5002363 and in the base space on older builds. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek.

patches_added.name: Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)
patches_added.description: Draws only the foveal image on a transparent canvas per eye. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395. Experimental; headset validation pending.

patches_added.name: GXR spacewarp layer (experimental)
patches_added.description: Synthesizes a frame when the stream misses a display tick; any failure stands down to stock. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363. Experimental; headset validation pending.

patches_added.name: OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST (experimental)
patches_added.description: Asks OpenXR for the CPU and GPU BOOST hint at session start; unsupported devices continue without it. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395.

patches_added.name: Alpha-0 high-resolution trigger
patches_added.description: Fully transparent high-resolution trigger quad that keeps Valve's native projection layout and formats untouched. Builds: 2.0.20 (5001712, 5001812), 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363, 2.0.24/5002395.

patches_added.name: Double tap to skip
patches_added.description: A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Home header text
patches_added.description: Shows your own words or picture at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo. Words take Facebook's own colors for light and dark mode. Type them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance > Home header text, or pick a picture under Home header picture. Blank keeps Facebook's logo.

patches_added.name: Tap shows the controls
patches_added.description: A tap on a playing reel shows its controls and lets it keep playing, so you can skip or mute without stopping it. The button in the middle still pauses. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, and stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Download any photo
patches_modified.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches_modified.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. A second switch does the same for videos playing in the feed and in Watch. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Inspect HTTPS traffic (adb reverse proxy)
patches_added.description: Routes RN network traffic through 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device (adb reverse tunnel to mitmproxy). Off by default; needs the tunnel and a trusted CA.

patches_added.name: Spoof stock signing cert hash
patches_added.description: Makes NativeUtils.setAppToken() return the stock app's certificate hash instead of the patched build's, so the server-side device/app integrity verdict ('App Error: NO IMSI') is not tripped by the re-signed APK.

patches_added.name: Kill residual beacon traffic
patches_added.description: Silences the Facebook SDK's remaining phone-home: app-event uploads (/activities, /app) and the SDK config fetch (mobile_sdk_gk). The SDK class init stays alive (required by RN); only transmission dies.

patches_added.name: Unlock hidden feature flags
patches_added.description: Flips the server-sent feature flags showO2A/showO2AShop/showO2ABuy/showUber/showDeleteAccount to true in every API response before the JS sees it, revealing app screens the server hides.

patches_modified.description: Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing individual folder control, and exports memory collages and creations to DCIM/Google Photos for quota-free backup.

patches_modified.description: Bypasses the 0MB Mobile Data Download check for AI models and fixes font loading across Stories and UI to prevent blank text and fallback fonts.

patches_modified.name: Official package name
patches_modified.description: Retains the official package name (com.google.android.apps.photos) instead of renaming to app.morphe.android.apps.photos and disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to maximum to prevent automatic overwriting. This is strictly for non-root users whose devices do not have Google Photos preinstalled by the OEM.

patches_modified.name: Spoof features
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.

patches_modified.name: App name
patches_modified.description: Changes the app name shown in the headset's library and in app info. The stock name is just "YouTube", which is easy to confuse with the store app.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts every video at one resolution instead of the app's per-video choice; a resolution the video lacks falls back to its highest available (8K included when the stream spoof provides it). Changeable in the headset's Patch settings; Auto keeps the app's own behaviour.

patches_modified.name: Extension
patches_modified.description: Injects the extension the other patches run through: its streaming spoof is what removes the pre-roll (ad-free playback) and provides the 8K format support. Turning this patch off restores ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides video ads, including the pre-roll when the streaming spoof is unavailable and the app falls back to its own player response.

patches_modified.name: Install as clone
patches_modified.description: Installs the patched app as a separate app by default, so it sits alongside the store's YouTube VR instead of replacing it. Replace mode keeps the official package name: the store copy has to be removed to satisfy the signing difference, Horizon OS then treats this build as the YouTube VR app (a restore prompt, and a warning on every reboot), and a store update will collide with it because this build is signed differently.

patches_modified.name: QUIC (HTTP/3)
patches_modified.description: Adds the in-headset switch for QUIC, the transport under HTTP/3: TLS over UDP, used for this app's API and media requests. Leave it on unless playback stalls on a network that blocks or throttles UDP 443 (corporate Wi-Fi, many VPNs), where turning it off forces TCP/TLS. A change applies after the app restarts.

patches_modified.description: @unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Quests banner
patches_modified.description: Removes the Quest promotion above your profile bar. Quests still work.

patches_modified.name: Hide the call button
patches_modified.description: Removes Call from people's profiles. Message fills the space.

patches_modified.name: Hide the gift button
patches_modified.description: Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.

patches_modified.name: Icon packs
patches_modified.description: Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.

patches_modified.name: Jump to first message
patches_modified.description: A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.

patches_modified.name: Message highlights
patches_modified.description: Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.

patches_modified.name: Pastel name colors
patches_modified.description: Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.

patches_modified.name: Read all button
patches_modified.description: A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.

patches_modified.name: Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
patches_modified.description: Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.

patches_modified.name: Send audio as voice messages
patches_modified.description: Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Send long messages
patches_modified.description: Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.

patches_modified.name: Server info
patches_modified.description: Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.

patches_modified.name: Show device indicators
patches_modified.description: Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.

patches_modified.name: Show file sizes when attaching
patches_modified.description: Photos and videos in the picker show their size.

patches_modified.name: Show hidden channels
patches_modified.description: Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.

patches_modified.name: Skip delete confirmation
patches_modified.description: Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.

patches_modified.name: Spaces in channel names
patches_modified.description: Shows "general chat" instead of "general-chat".

patches_modified.name: Translate messages
patches_modified.description: Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.

patches_modified.name: Use your phone's emojis
patches_modified.description: Your phone's emojis instead of Discord's, in chat, reactions and the emoji picker.

patches_modified.name: Use your phone's font
patches_modified.description: Replaces Discord's font (gg sans) with your phone's, everywhere. Android 9 or newer.

patches_modified.name: User activity notifications
patches_modified.description: Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.

patches_modified.name: User and server reviews
patches_modified.description: Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).

patches_modified.name: Venus button on profile bar
patches_modified.description: A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches_modified.name: Venus settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.

patches_modified.name: Block Trackers
patches_modified.description: Blocks crash reporting, ad attribution and referral tracking.

patches_modified.name: Remove Extra Files
patches_modified.description: Deletes tutorial videos, editor stickers and junk to shrink the app.

patches_modified.name: Stop Background Sync
patches_modified.description: Stops background sync tasks and alarms that drain the battery.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Pro features stored on the device (routines, folders, charts). Server-limited items may still need a subscription.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, AppsFlyer, and ByteDance AppLog event dispatchers.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Effects Region Restriction
patches_modified.description: Fixes effects, transitions, and templates failing to load (ByteDance Shark WAF block) by spoofing device_platform to 'windows' and resetting deviceId in effect requests.

patches_modified.name: Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut GeoBlock config lists (cert, dock, entrance, page, scheme) to empty so region-blocked surfaces stay enabled. Server-refused content may still fail to load.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Signature Check
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the official APK signature (SHA-256) for tamper telemetry, drops the server-driven signature blacklist, silences the abnormal-source toast, and disables the Godzilla inject-detect gate so re-signed builds are not blocked.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Unsafe Package Modal
patches_modified.description: Replaces the unsafe-package modal fallback URL in the Lynx schema defaults with the real template portal URL so region-blocked or untrusted-client fallbacks open templates instead of the blocking security notice.

patches_modified.name: Locale Assets Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected CapCut asset locale bundles (assets/locales/*.json) from the APK. English is always preserved. For res/values-* string tables use the canonical universal Remove Extra Languages patch.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips non-essential companion native libraries by zeroing bytes in-situ. Always zeroes AppLovin ad crash reporter. WARNING: Stripping speech recognition and synthesis engines (libspeech*.so) disables voice recognition, voiceover captions, and speech-to-text features.

patches_modified.name: Remove Watermark
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates to allow export without watermark (WatermarkBusinessFunction).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut VIP gates to return true (SubscribeImpl, PayVipImpl, UserVipInfo, UserDetailInfo, VipUserServiceImpl, SubscribeCloudImpl) plus central account status flags (BusinessManager). Cloud-gated assets may still fail.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium Templates
patches_modified.description: Marks premium template styles as available so locked template features stay usable.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Ultra HD Export
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut Ultra HD / high-resolution export gates to unlocked so 4K export options stay available.

patches_modified.name: Background Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Disables background periodic jobs, home screen widgets, and companion services to reduce resource usage.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Blocks tracking services, analytics collection, and advertising identifiers, redirects Braze and Sentry endpoints to 0.0.0.0, and purges Sentry manifest metadata.

patches_added.name: Anonymous chat
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that opens Kick's chat as a guest, the way Kick opens it when you're signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in: the chat page gets neither your sign-in token nor your account's name and ID, so its own connection to Kick's chat isn't yours. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on, and messages that mention you aren't highlighted. Kick can still tell that you are watching: the player's playback request (postPlayerTelemetry) and the app's own live connection still identify you. Checked signed out only; whether Kick then leaves you off a channel's chatter list needs an account to see. The switch applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_added.name: Mute stitched live ads
patches_added.description: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. While Kick's player reports an ad break stitched into a live stream, mutes the player and covers the video with black and a small "Ad break", then restores both when the break's time is up, it ends, or another stream loads. The ad still plays for its full length and can't be skipped; this only silences and hides it. It acts on the ad signals Kick's player can get: an ad cue or ad break from Amazon IVS, or an ad of a MediaTailor session, which Kick only starts with Disable analytics off. None arrived in signed-out sessions, so this was checked only with made-up ad signals fed to Kick's own player code. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Show video stats
patches_added.description: Shows a small panel in the corner of the player with what Kick's video player reports, refreshed every second: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate and the network estimate, buffer, dropped frames, quality and codecs. The numbers come from the player on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere, and the panel never takes a tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time next to each chat message, in 24-hour (13:05) or 12-hour (1:05) format as on Twitch. Kick's own chat settings can show times for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while on, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the times, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the time next to each chat message. Kick's own chat settings have the same option for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while on, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the times, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: AMOLED black
patches_added.description: Turns the dark grey of Rumble's raised surfaces (the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags) pure black for OLED screens, optionally near-black so their edges still show. Rumble's dark theme already draws pages, sheets and dialogs black; dividers and buttons keep their grey. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: AMOLED black
patches_added.description: Turns the dark theme's greys black on screens drawn with Android views: the window and navigation bar, Home, Browse and channel pages, the theatre and chat, whose backgrounds are repainted after each layout. Screens Twitch draws with Compose (parts of settings, the emote picker and some sheets) and pop-up sheets keep their dark grey. Only in Twitch's dark mode. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Auto-claim Drops
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that claims a Drop for your account as soon as Twitch's drops notification in a channel shows it as claimable, by pressing that notification's Claim button for you: the same claim request and the same "claim" analytics event a tap sends (Disable analytics blocks the event). Each drop is claimed once per app start. Needs a signed-in account and the notification, which shows while you watch a channel with Drops; drops earned elsewhere stay in your inventory. Checked against Twitch's code on Android's runtime, not yet with a real account. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Clip download
patches_added.description: Adds "Download clip" to the menu (⋮) of a clip in Twitch's clips feed, where clip links open. It asks gql.twitch.tv for the clip's video addresses and signed access token with the app's Client-ID only (no account), and Android's download manager saves the best quality as an MP4 in Downloads/Twitch. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Compact chat
patches_added.description: Adds switches that leave chatters' badges out of native chat lines (Twitch's and third-party ones) and show emotes as their text, so no emote images load. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; React Native chat is unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Force landscape
patches_added.description: Turns the screen to landscape when a live stream or video opens in Twitch's native theatre, and back to the orientation the app had when the theatre closes. Twitch's rotate button still switches to portrait. Home's feed previews don't rotate. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Highlight first-time chatters
patches_added.description: Tints a chatter's first message in a channel in native live chat, using the first-msg tag Twitch's chat server puts on it. Chat history, VOD replay and React Native chat carry no such tag. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Latency badge
patches_added.description: Shows how far a live stream plays behind the broadcast on Twitch's native player in the theatre, read from the player itself once a second (the latency the stats panel reports). Tapping it reloads the stream through Twitch's own Retry, a new access token and playlist that start at the live edge: the native player has no seek to live. Feed previews, videos and clips show nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback. A lower rendition for metered networks (mobile data, or Wi-Fi marked as metered) can be chosen in Lurk settings > Playback > On mobile data; it's the same as on Wi-Fi until then.
patches_modified.previous_description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server, and for live streams the stream's uptime, from the stream age Twitch's playlist already carries. Everything shown is local to the player.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. When on, each sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. "Emotes in the picker" also lists them in the emote picker, one section per service, and in autocomplete after ':', from the same lists; that part was checked with Twitch's own picker and autocomplete code on Android's runtime, not in the app, which needs an account to open the picker. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Unread dots and counts change with it. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Always upload in HD
patches_modified.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: App lock
patches_modified.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Automatic video advance
patches_modified.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block popups
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches_modified.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches_modified.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain or your own picture. Only patching again without it puts the old icon back.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Each corner of the video can get its own action too. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Hushfeed settings. Find it in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

patches_modified.name: Feed text sizes
patches_modified.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick a size in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen, and can stop a right swipe on For You from opening the side menu. Each has its own switch, and all start off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
