patches_added.name: Add your own media apps as Waze audio partners
patches_added.description: Waze's audio-partner list is a table compiled into the app - it contains Spotify and an internal demo, and Waze never scans installed apps (getInstalledPackages has zero references in the APK). One patch for the whole media feature: it adds your own entries to that table at the point where Waze persists each partner's scope, and declares the media browser service in Waze's manifest, without which Android hides your players from Waze entirely. Waze's own availability check is opened as well: any installed app qualifies as a partner, and Waze reaches it through the generic media-browser client instead of requiring Waze's own SDK.

patches_added.name: Map theme
patches_added.description: Recolours Waze's own map skin (Google Maps-like light/dark, or OLED black) by rewriting the compiled skin descriptions in the APK, and raises the app's versionCode so Waze re-extracts its skins instead of serving the cached stock ones. Applied at patch time: change the theme by re-patching. No injected code, nothing to render at runtime.

patches_added.name: OLED dark mode
patches_added.description: Makes the night map truly dark for OLED screens: the map background becomes pure black (#000000) and the road colours are lifted slightly (one Waze lighten step) so they stay readable against it. Only the background and the road palette change - day mode, labels, traffic and routes are left as Waze ships them. Applied at patch time: no runtime switch and nothing injected into the app. Steps aside if Map theme is also selected.

patches_added.name: Unlock driver moods
patches_added.description: Waze's mood picker is gated three ways: an eligibility check that accepts only one mood name (and reads the beta-moods flag), a baby-account gate that hides moods, and a filtered native catalogue call. This opens all three, so moods already in the local catalogue - including special and hidden entries - become selectable. Artwork Waze has never downloaded is not invented.

patches_added.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches_added.description: Replaces Waze's stock night map with an AMOLED one: the map canvas becomes true black (#000000) and the nine road families are lifted 15% toward white so they keep their contrast against it. Only the night skins change - day mode, labels, traffic and route colours stay as Waze ships them. Applied at patch time: no runtime switch, nothing injected.

patches_added.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches_added.description: Stops the Play Store from offering or applying updates to Waze: the manifest version code is locked above Play's maximum (2,100,000,000 + minutes), so the store always sees the installed copy as newer than its listing. The value advances on every re-patch, so Waze still refreshes its extracted resources, and Waze's own package-version accessor keeps reporting the pre-lock code. Ported from Morphe's universal "Disable Play Store updates" (GPLv3).

patches_added.name: Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
patches_added.description: Makes Morphe YouTube Music (app.morphe.android.apps.youtube.music) usable as Waze's audio partner: the package is declared in Waze's manifest so Android's package visibility lets Waze see it, and it is added to the audio-partner table (SdkConfiguration.appConfigs) whenever Waze rebuilds that roster. Ported from Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch (GPLv3).

patches_removed.name: Config overrides
patches_removed.description: Applies the configuration changes requested by the other patches. Applied automatically; there is nothing to configure.

patches_removed.name: Wire Morphe YouTube Music into Waze
patches_removed.description: Replaces the official YouTube Music entry with your Morphe YouTube Music: the package Waze launches and the row label, at the single point every audio-partner list entry is built from - plus both launch paths as a fallback.

patches_removed.name: Add your own media apps as Waze audio partners
patches_removed.description: Waze's audio-partner list is a table compiled into the app - it contains Spotify and an internal demo, and Waze never scans installed apps (getInstalledPackages has zero references in the APK). One patch for the whole media feature: it adds your own entries to that table at the point where Waze persists each partner's scope, and declares the media browser service in Waze's manifest, without which Android hides your players from Waze entirely. Waze's own availability check is opened as well: any installed app qualifies as a partner, and Waze reaches it through the generic media-browser client instead of requiring Waze's own SDK.

patches_removed.name: Map theme
patches_removed.description: Recolours Waze's own map skin (Google Maps-like light/dark, or OLED black) by rewriting the compiled skin descriptions in the APK, and raises the app's versionCode so Waze re-extracts its skins instead of serving the cached stock ones. Applied at patch time: change the theme by re-patching. No injected code, nothing to render at runtime.

patches_removed.name: OLED dark mode
patches_removed.description: Makes the night map truly dark for OLED screens: the map background becomes pure black (#000000) and the road colours are lifted slightly (one Waze lighten step) so they stay readable against it. Only the background and the road palette change - day mode, labels, traffic and routes are left as Waze ships them. Applied at patch time: no runtime switch and nothing injected into the app. Steps aside if Map theme is also selected.

patches_removed.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches_removed.description: Replaces Waze's stock night map with an AMOLED one: the map canvas becomes true black (#000000) and the nine road families are lifted 15% toward white so they keep their contrast against it. Only the night skins change - day mode, labels, traffic and route colours stay as Waze ships them. Applied at patch time: no runtime switch, nothing injected.

patches_modified.name: Allow high refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Waze rejects any display mode above 60 Hz when it picks the mode for its surface, so a 120 Hz screen is served 60 Hz. This raises that ceiling to the requested rate (120 Hz by default). Costs battery and heat - off by default.

patches_modified.name: Auto zoom
patches_modified.description: Pins Waze's own auto-zoom setting (no / yes / speed) and keeps it across server config sync. Waze ships the row itself; this makes the choice stick.

patches_modified.name: Average-speed camera alerts
patches_modified.description: Enables average-speed camera alerts and recommended-speed guidance.

patches_modified.name: Brief voice guidance
patches_modified.description: Enables Waze's brief voice-guidance mode.

patches_modified.name: Enable police & enforcement alerts
patches_modified.description: Turns on Waze's police/enforcement alert system.

patches_modified.name: Extended police & hazard alert distances
patches_modified.description: Increases the pre-alert distances for police enforcement, accidents and heavy traffic.

patches_modified.name: Lane guidance
patches_modified.description: Enables lane guidance, including continue-straight hints.

patches_modified.name: Radar sound at any speed
patches_modified.description: Plays speed-camera sound alerts even when not above the limit.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Forces Waze's advertising config values off.

patches_modified.name: Show all cameras & road hazards
patches_modified.description: Shows speed cameras, red-light cameras and speed bumps on the map and enables their notifications.

patches_modified.name: Speed limit sign always shown
patches_modified.description: Forces the speed-limit sign on and enables the manual overrides.

patches_modified.name: Speed-limit decrease warnings
patches_modified.description: Enables warnings when the speed limit drops, with an extended pre-alert distance.

patches_modified.name: Speedometer always on
patches_modified.description: Keeps the speedometer visible at any speed, including while stopped.

patches_modified.name: Dart Pro gates (libapp.so)
patches_modified.description: Applies the 10 Dart AOT hex patches to libapp.so that unlock the native Pro gates.

patches_modified.name: Premium Unlock
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Calistree PRO features.

patches_modified.name: Dart Pro gates (libapp.so)
patches_modified.description: Applies the 10 Dart AOT hex patches to libapp.so that unlock the native Pro gates.

patches_modified.name: Premium Unlock
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Calistree PRO features.

patches_added.name: Unlock VPN Plus
patches_added.description: Unlocks Plus features and routes connections through free servers

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features

patches_modified.name: Bypass anti-tamper (foodpanda)
patches_modified.description: Bypasses foodpanda's DeliveryHero MAS integrity block — forces the master security gate (`w9u.a`) to report the device/app as trusted AND short-circuits the enforcement orchestrator that launches the block screen, so re-signed / sideloaded builds no longer hit the "This device or application is not supported" BlockedActivity.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses foodpanda's DeliveryHero MAS integrity block — forces the master security gate (`w9u.a`) to report the device/app as trusted, so re-signed / sideloaded builds no longer hit the "This device or application is not supported" BlockedActivity.

patches_added.name: Avoid Flock cameras
patches_added.description: Steers driving directions around Flock cameras: when Google's route passes one, a camera-free way is worked out with BRouter, an OpenStreetMap router, and Maps asks Google again for a route through it, so Google still times and navigates the trip, and keeps it through reroutes. A detour longer than half again the distance is dropped. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, with Flock cameras; your route's start and end go to brouter.de. Trips with stops are left as they are.

patches_modified.name: Flock cameras
patches_modified.description: Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the ones near you from an OpenStreetMap server, over the same area as the speed cameras.
patches_modified.previous_description: Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the ones near you from an OpenStreetMap server, over the same area as the speed cameras.

patches_modified.name: Speed cameras
patches_modified.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server -- an area you choose there, about 25 to 175 km across.
patches_modified.previous_description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server -- an area you choose there, about 25 to 175 km across.

patches_modified.name: Speeding chime
patches_modified.description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet.

patches_modified.name: Waze alerts
patches_modified.description: Shows the alerts a Waze on the same phone is tracking -- police to begin with, and any of crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- as pins on the map, with a chime and a note as one comes up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source. Waze has to be patched with Share alerts with Maps, signed in and open; in the background is enough.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the alerts a Waze on the same phone is tracking -- police to begin with, and any of crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- as pins on the map, with a chime and a note as one comes up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze Features. Waze has to be patched with Share alerts with Maps, signed in and open; in the background is enough.

patches_modified.name: Alert distances
patches_modified.description: How far ahead, in metres, Waze warns of police, hazards, crashes, traffic jams and speed cameras. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (CGE); Waze's own are lower for most of them. They can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu.
patches_modified.previous_description: How far ahead, in metres, Waze warns of police, hazards, crashes, traffic jams and speed cameras. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (CGE); Waze's own are lower for most of them.

patches_modified.name: Bigger speedometer
patches_modified.description: Bigger digits on the speedometer, and on the speed limit sign beside it, so they can be read at a glance. The sizes can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu, where a switch also gives Waze's own sizes back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bigger digits on the speedometer, and on the speed limit sign beside it, so they can be read at a glance.

patches_modified.name: Navigation distances
patches_modified.description: How far ahead Android Auto gives its heads-up, and how long a jam must last before the traffic bar shows it. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (Chuppito). They can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu.
patches_modified.previous_description: How far ahead Android Auto gives its heads-up, and how long a jam must last before the traffic bar shows it. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (Chuppito).

patches_modified.name: Share alerts with Maps
patches_modified.description: Hands the alerts Waze is tracking -- police, crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- to Ungoogled Maps on the same phone, where Waze alerts in Waze & external data source puts them on the map. Nothing leaves the phone. Waze has to be signed in and open; in the background is enough.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hands the alerts Waze is tracking -- police, crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- to Ungoogled Maps on the same phone, where Waze alerts in Waze Features puts them on the map. Nothing leaves the phone. Waze has to be signed in and open; in the background is enough.

patches_modified.name: Speed limit sign
patches_modified.description: The style of the speed limit sign beside the speedometer, whatever the country. It can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu.
patches_modified.previous_description: The style of the speed limit sign beside the speedometer, whatever the country.

patches_modified.name: Stay awake in the background
patches_modified.description: Lets Waze keep running in the background without a route for the chosen time -- Waze's server allows 10 minutes -- so that its alerts keep reaching Maps while you navigate there. Costs battery; Waze still closes itself when you close it. The time can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets Waze keep running in the background without a route for the chosen time -- Waze's server allows 10 minutes -- so that its alerts keep reaching Maps while you navigate there. Costs battery; Waze still closes itself when you close it.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the app icon, on Android 13 and up. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. On Telegram Beta it also turns off Firebase's crash and session reports from the next start. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable call debug upload
patches_modified.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_modified.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Folders by chat type
patches_modified.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches_modified.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches_modified.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches_modified.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in the side menu, Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps
patches_modified.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches_modified.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off beta debug logs
patches_modified.description: Telegram Beta always writes debug logs to your phone, its connection log included, and its own debug menu can't stop that. This stops them, so the beta only logs when you turn logs on in its debug menu. The regular telegram.org build doesn't force them, so nothing changes there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the app icon, on Android 13 and up. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. On Telegram Beta it also turns off Firebase's crash and session reports from the next start. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable call debug upload
patches_modified.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_modified.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Folders by chat type
patches_modified.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches_modified.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches_modified.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches_modified.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in the side menu, Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps
patches_modified.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches_modified.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off beta debug logs
patches_modified.description: Telegram Beta always writes debug logs to your phone, its connection log included, and its own debug menu can't stop that. This stops them, so the beta only logs when you turn logs on in its debug menu. The regular telegram.org build doesn't force them, so nothing changes there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Unlock Prime
patches_added.description: Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime by bypassing the static (isPrime) gate. WARNING: May cause crashes.

patches_removed.name: Enable Prime (Experimental)
patches_removed.description: Enables Nova Launcher Prime WARNING: May cause crashes.

patches_modified.name: Remove Internet permission (Nova)
patches_modified.description: Removes INTERNET permission from Nova Launcher and disables network-only entry points so Nova does not crash.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium Features
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Arc Player premium by forcing isPremiumUser to return true.

patches_modified.name: Glass Panel
patches_modified.description: Turns the translucent keyboard panel into glass. On vivo OriginOS it uses the system's own glass material, with real refraction, rim light and dispersion; elsewhere it draws lit edges and a sheen. Keys are left as they are. Works on top of Translucent Bottom Bar and Frosted Glass.
patches_modified.previous_description: Gives the translucent keyboard panel a glass look with lit edges, a faint sheen and a bright top rim, leaving the keys as they are. Works on top of Translucent Bottom Bar and Frosted Glass.

patches_modified.name: Glass Panel

Works on top of Translucent Bottom Bar and Frosted Glass.
patches_modified.previous_description: Gives the translucent keyboard panel a glass look with lit edges, a faint sheen and a bright top rim, leaving the keys as they are. Works on top of Translucent Bottom Bar and Frosted Glass.

patches_added.name: Skip splash delay
patches_added.description: Opens the app without waiting on the splash screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking
patches_modified.description: Stops the install identifier from reaching Expo and usage events from reaching Google. Disables OTA updates.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks unlimited move views, goals and move cards, manual sync, earlier library updates and card customization. Disables OTA updates.

patches_added.name: Profile background
patches_added.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_added.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name, and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown, can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, and can offer a quality choice in more LIVE rooms. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown, can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, and can offer a quality choice in every LIVE room. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied, hides that you're on a VPN, and gives it a blank advertising ID so apps can't match you by it. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Notes in Hushfeed's diagnostic report when TikTok shows a verification puzzle. Its hide switch isn't available on this TikTok version, so every puzzle still shows. Works as soon as you patch it in.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.
patches_modified.previous_description: Notes in the diagnostic report when TikTok's account safety check decides to show a verification puzzle. It doesn't hide anything, so it's only useful for research. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count. Optional received-message and draft translation previews are under Inbox settings.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Waze alerts
patches_added.description: Shows the alerts a Waze on the same phone is tracking -- police to begin with, and any of crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- as pins on the map, with a chime and a note as one comes up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze Features. Waze has to be patched with Share alerts with Maps, signed in and open; in the background is enough.

patches_added.name: Flock cameras
patches_added.description: Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the ones near you from an OpenStreetMap server, over the same area as the speed cameras.

patches_modified.name: Speed cameras
patches_modified.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server -- an area you choose there, about 25 to 175 km across.
patches_modified.previous_description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server.

patches_added.name: Share alerts with Maps
patches_added.description: Hands the alerts Waze is tracking -- police, crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- to Ungoogled Maps on the same phone, where Waze alerts in Waze Features puts them on the map. Nothing leaves the phone. Waze has to be signed in and open; in the background is enough.

patches_added.name: Stay awake in the background
patches_added.description: Lets Waze keep running in the background without a route for the chosen time -- Waze's server allows 10 minutes -- so that its alerts keep reaching Maps while you navigate there. Costs battery; Waze still closes itself when you close it.

patches_modified.name: Skip silence

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls

patches_modified.name: Theme

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves

patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.
